page.layout: One column of italic verse, centred-ragged, with a signature mark at the foot right. Running head centred at top; page number top right.

p.i: Quod Veritatis feruida candidæ Ignes per orbem spargere lucidos: Et fraudis inuisas fugare Tartareæ meditatur umbras.
O TAM celebri nunc ter & amplius Regnata felix Anglia Principe! O nunc triumphatis Iberum Nobilior ducibus superbis!
Nunc nunc Britanni Cœlituum Patrem Laudare tempus, nunc fora, compita, Et templa, diuinos fauores Perpetuo resonate cantu.
Lucémque festam quæ redeuntibus Ridebit annis semper Adoreâ: Quæ fudit Hispanos potentes Per memores celebrate fastos.
Fas & fauenti plaudere murmure Quos cura Christi prouida fustinet Cum frangit hostes, cum nefandæ Turba perit truculenta gentis.
Quacunque lucis conscia Olympicæ Terras per omnes æthereum colis, Gens sacra patrem fœderatis Pectoribus sociate vota.
Vt tanta cunctis sospes ab hostibus Regina, vitæ tempora prorogans Felicis, Antiquos Britannos Imperiis moderetur æquis.

page.notes: Printed page 7 with running head IBERICA. Text is set in italic throughout; the initial capitals Q, O, N, L, F, Q, Q and V are decorative and copied as plain letters. "Iberum" is printed with a long-s form, read as Iberum. The signature mark at the foot reads "A .iiij." in print, given here as "A iiij".
